A high-quality mixed-media portrait of a trendy Surrounding the realistic main subject are several cute, 3D-style 'Chibi' versions of the theirself. same wears and same face. prompts.title: Gemini Nano Banana Pro 的电影人像提示词
prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于让 Gemini Nano Banana Pro 生成一张高度逼真的电影级年轻男子肖像，保留参考照片中的面部特征，背景设定在带有戏剧性彩色烟雾效果的摄影棚中。
prompts.content:
Create a highly realistic cinematic portrait of a cool young man based on the uploaded reference photo, preserving the same facial identity, facial structure, and overall look. The young man has wavy vintage style hair, neatly styled with a clean cut appearance that frames his face naturally. His expression is calm and confident as he looks slightly to the right, giving a relaxed and thoughtful vibe.

He is seated comfortably on a simple wooden crate in a studio setting. His posture is casual with one leg slightly forward and his shoulders relaxed. In one hand he loosely holds a denim jacket draped naturally over his arm as if he just took it off.

He is wearing a plain loose white t shirt with a soft cotton texture and light colored baggie jeans that fit casually. The fabric folds and natural creases add realism to the clothing while maintaining a minimal stylish look.

The background is a dramatic black studio environment with atmospheric smoke effects in {argument name="smoke color 1" default="blue"} and {argument name="smoke color 2" default="red"} tones slowly spreading behind him. The colored smoke creates a soft glowing contrast against the dark background and adds depth to the scene. Subtle studio lighting highlights the edges of his hair, shoulders, and clothing, while soft shadows fall around the wooden crate.

Professional studio portrait photography style, captured with a full frame camera using an 85mm lens. Shallow depth of field keeps the subject in sharp focus while the colored smoke softly blurs in the background. Ultra photorealistic lighting, natural skin texture, cinematic color grading, high contrast, extremely detailed, 8k resolution.
prompts.translatedContent:
根据上传的参考照片，创作一张高度逼真的电影风格年轻男子肖像，保留相同的面部特征、面部结构和整体外观。这位年轻男子留着波浪状复古发型，造型整洁，剪裁利落，自然地勾勒出他的脸庞。他神情平静而自信，目光略微向右看，散发出一种放松而沉思的氛围。

他舒适地坐在一间工作室里的一个简易木箱上。他的姿势随意，一条腿略微向前，双肩放松。他一只手松散地拿着一件牛仔夹克，夹克自然地搭在他的手臂上，仿佛他刚脱下。

他穿着一件柔软棉质的纯白色宽松 T 恤，搭配浅色宽松牛仔裤，穿着随意。面料的褶皱和自然折痕为服装增添了真实感，同时保持了简约时尚的外观。

背景是一个戏剧性的黑色工作室环境，{argument name="smoke color 1" default="blue"} 和 {argument name="smoke color 2" default="red"} 色调的氛围烟雾在他身后缓缓弥漫。彩色烟雾在黑暗的背景下形成了柔和的发光对比，为场景增添了深度。微妙的工作室灯光勾勒出他的头发、肩膀和衣服的边缘，而柔和的阴影则落在木箱周围。

专业的影棚肖像摄影风格，使用全画幅相机和 85mm 镜头拍摄。浅景深使主体保持清晰对焦，而彩色烟雾在背景中柔和模糊。超逼真的光线，自然的皮肤纹理，电影般的色彩分级，高对比度，极其细致，8k 分辨率。

prompts.title: 电影中景，粉笔板背景提示
prompts.description: 一个为 Nano Banana Pro (v.053) 设计的详细提示，用于生成一个电影般的特写镜头：主体靠在一块写满了字的黑色黑板上，指定了服装、灯光（柔和、漫射、中调）和色彩分级（暖色、去饱和的深褐色，带一点黄绿色调）。
prompts.content: Image from subject, cinematic medium shot with a slight low-angle perspective. The subject is leaning back against a surface, in a three-quarter profile view, gazing thoughtfully off-camera to the side. Wearing a rumpled white button-up shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a dark textured necktie loosely knotted, and brown chino pants. Standing against an expansive, worn black chalkboard covered in dense white chalk writing, diagrams, arrows, and philosophical text. The lighting is soft, diffused, and medium-key, originating from the right, creating gentle, open shadows and evenly illuminating the scene without harsh highlights. The overall image is brightly lit with moderate contrast, preserving detail in the mid-tones of the shirt and skin. Color grading is a warm, desaturated sepia with a distinct greenish-yellow tint, characteristic of aged film under warm fluorescent light. Blacks are slightly lifted but not crushed. Medium 50mm film grain is present throughout.
prompts.translatedContent: 主体图像，电影中景，略带低角度视角。主体靠在某个表面上，呈四分之三侧面，若有所思地凝视着镜头外侧。身穿一件褶皱的白色纽扣衬衫，袖子卷起，一条深色有纹理的领带松散地打着结，下身是棕色斜纹棉布裤。站在一块宽阔、磨损的黑色黑板前，黑板上密密麻麻地写满了白色粉笔字、图表、箭头和哲学文本。灯光柔和、漫射、中等亮度，来自右侧，营造出柔和、开放的阴影，均匀照亮场景，没有刺眼的强光。整体图像明亮，对比度适中，保留了衬衫和皮肤中间调的细节。色彩分级为温暖、去饱和的棕褐色，带有明显的绿黄色调，这是暖荧光灯下老旧胶片的典型特征。黑色略微提亮，但未被压暗。整个画面呈现中等 50mm 胶片颗粒感。
